The learned Munsif did not decree the suit for the first two declarations, prayed for, but decreed-it in part declaring that the order of dismissal from service dated 4.8.75 is illegal, void, without jurisdiction, and ultra vires On appeal, defendant, Administrator, District Board, Mymensingh and also on cross appeals by the plaintiff the learned Subordinate Judge dismissed the appeal, allowed the cross-appeal of the plaintiff and gave him all the 3 declarations he prayed for. 

 In the result, the appeal is allowed but without any order as to costs. The judgment and decree of the learned Subordinate Judge are set aside and the plaintiff's suit is dismissed without any order as to costs.
